description: Verifies a remote agent's A2A /.well-known/agent.json discovery card, checking JWS/DID signature binding, endpoint HTTPS enforcement, and capability spoofing. Use when authenticating a peer autonomous agent before delegating subtasks or exchanging payments over A2A; for auditing an MCP tool server's tools/list manifest rather than a peer agent's A2A card, use audit_mcp_server_manifest instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'agent_card_json' ('trust_policy' defaults to 'require_https_and_did'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

agent_card_json.description: JSON string or object of the peer agent's /.well-known/agent.json descriptor.

trust_policy.description: Verification policy for DID/DNS binding; defaults to 'require_https_and_did' when omitted.

name: verify_a2a_agent_card

agent_id.description: Canonical identifier of the verified peer agent.

card_valid.description: True when the A2A agent card schema, transport, and identity claims pass verification.

spoofing_flags.description: List of impersonation or downgrade anomalies detected.

title: A2A /.well-known/agent.json Identity & Capability Card Verifier
